verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a public REST API (v2) that uses OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth with scoped credentials. Its endpoint references cover transfers, fiat accounts and deposits, orders and quotes, identity onboarding and orchestrations. It also offers FIX and WebSocket APIs and a sandbox that replicates the v2 API for testing. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
